messages:
marta: Quick async: did a smoke onboarding pass for en-legal-v2 (tinyq). Ran the baseline eval suite, saw a small regression on clause-extraction precision (~3% drop). Pushed a snapshot to model-registry: registry/en-legal-v2@2026-03-16-smoke. Linking artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/en-legal-v2/smoke-2460123456.tar.gz

john.h: Thanks — can you paste the failing example or metric table? curious if it's skewed by prompt formatting.

marta: here's the failing snippet that tripped the extractor on a nested clause: ```input: "If the Seller fails to deliver, the Buyer may terminate and seek damages under Section 5.1(b)." expected: ["Seller fails to deliver", "Buyer may terminate", "seek damages"] model_out: ["Seller fails to deliver", "Buyer may terminate and seek damages under Section 5.1(b)"]``` Looks like the model is not splitting short conjunctions.

liam: fyi i opened PR #1423 to add a prompt rewrite that inserts a delimiter hint and a small post-process splitter. needs review: https://github.com/redwood/inference-evals/pull/1423 :eyes:

sara: blocker: customer-data team flagged the prompt rewrite because it touches PII normalization stage. we need a short privacy review before merging. @marta can you add a brief note on how the rewrite interacts with normalization?

marta: yes, the rewrite only adds a deterministic token ("|||DELIM|||") between clauses before model call and strips it after. no changes to KMS or normalization. i added a short rationale in the PR description.

john.h: can we run the smoke with the rewrite as a diff? run_command: ```python run_smoke.py --model registry/en-legal-v2@smoke --prompt-patch scripts/insert_delim.py --output smoke-patch.json``` if someone with staging creds can kick that off?

ci-bot: CI started for PR #1423 — 3 jobs queued (unit, smoke-eval, lint). Estimated ETA ~6m.

eva: i kicked off the run on staging-3. smoke-eval job id: smoke-2460124600. i'll post results when done. :thumbsup:

liam: also pinging @john.h for a quick review on the post-process splitter. small, under 30 LOC.

sara: once smoke passes, i'll request privacy sign-off. timeline: aiming to merge and roll out canary tomorrow morning if all clear.

marta: plan for today: 1) monitor smoke results, 2) triage any failing cases into the hotlist, 3) prepare rollback notes for rollout doc. blockers: privacy sign-off and an unclear failure on one Spanish contract sample (investigating).

john.h: noted. i'll do code review in next 30m. if smoke still failing, we can revert the prompt patch or enable a fallback to old variant via routing.

eva: smoke-eval finished: precision on clause-extraction improved by +1.2% with prompt patch but recall dropped 0.8%. full diff uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/en-legal-v2/smoke-2460124600/diff.json

marta: thanks. i'll inspect the drop cases and add a few targeted prompt examples to recover recall. will post quick update later in thread.

liam: thumbs for the workflow. small ask: can we add a short note in the model card about prompt hinting experiments? customers sometimes ask if prompt engineering is required.

marta: yep will add a short section "prompt hints" to the model card and link to the PR.

sara: if nothing else, i'm unblocked on the privacy side once marta's note is in PR. after that i'll request approval.

marta: update: added 6 targeted prompts and re-ran quick subset. recall recovered ~0.9% locally. re-uploading: s3://redwood-evals/en-legal-v2/smoke-2460126000. will merge PR after john.h review and privacy ack.

john.h: reviewed and left a minor nit. approving after nits fixed.

marta: fixed nits, pinging for merge. thanks all.
